author: A Google user
review_text: I'm using this app for a long time and it's excellent. I don't see any problems within the app and the developers are doing excellent job updating the features frequently. The only problem I'm seeing is the lack of interaction and no response to the suggestions from the users. I can understand that revenue from SMS is one of the source of income and without that the service what we're getting might be affected but at least this thing can be replied to the users who are commenting all the time.
